rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before accessing orders. It listed recent orders, pulled detailed order data, identified the correct order containing the luggage set, and checked product availability. When the requested replacement (medium black coat/fleece) was unavailable, the agent offered an alternative. Upon the user’s decision to cancel, the agent restated the exact action (cancel order #W3361211), requested explicit confirmation with a reason, then executed the cancellation on a pending order. The tool confirms the order was cancelled and refunded; the agent’s final message correctly reflected the refund amount and payment method. All actions were on the authenticated user’s account, and no writes were done without confirmation. The only minor unsourced detail is the 5–7 business day refund window, but this does not affect the core compliance or correctness of the outcome.
